ios-layout|Split views.summary: Plenix on iOS compares two versions of one item the way the web’s version comparison does: on iPad and in landscape the two versions side by side in the columns of a split view, each headed by its version and date in DM Mono, the changed values marked with a Changed badge; on iPhone one version after the other with a segmented control to switch, a slider over two pictures, or the text’s lines with the added and removed ones marked by a sign and a word. Apple’s default is the split view’s plain columns; Plenix keeps the split view, its column widths and its gestures, and changes the look: Plenix surfaces, DM Sans and DM Mono, and the success and danger soft surfaces for added and removed lines.

variants.name: Text diff

anatomy.name: Version header
anatomy.about: The version’s name in DM Sans and its date and author in DM Mono, always shown.

anatomy.name: Version pickers
anatomy.about: Two menus, Compare and With, each listing the versions with their dates; Swap exchanges them.

anatomy.name: Changed badge
anatomy.about: A badge with its icon and the word Changed beside each value that differs from the first version.

anatomy.name: Diff line
anatomy.about: A text line in DM Mono with both line numbers, a sign, and Added or Removed for VoiceOver.

anatomy.name: Change steps
anatomy.about: Previous change and Next change in the toolbar move to each change.
